experiment_data.hypothesis: R3-only GRPO with max_completion_length=512 (vs 256 in exp-003). Tests whether truncation is a contributing factor to reward failure. If 512 improves R3-only trajectory → truncation confound empirically confirmed. All other params identical to exp-003 (R3=1.0, r1=r2=0, gs=2, seed=42, 8000 steps).

spec.command: bash -c "export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True && export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 && export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 && source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/contrastive_entrain_calib && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 python training/run_exp003_len512_r3only.py"
